[[File:Heal Other icon (mobile).png|left]]
'''Heal Other''' transfers up to 75% of the caster's current [[hitpoints]] to the targeted player. The targeted player must have [[Accept Aid]] turned on to be healed by this spell, thus making it impossible for ironmen to be healed by others. As with all [[Lunar spells]], the quest [[Lunar Diplomacy]] must be completed to cast this spell. Additionally, a player needs at least 11% of their hitpoints to cast this spell.

Some players may choose to use this spell as a method of training [[Magic]] in tandem with another player. One player would cast the spell on another, who would then cast it on them, resulting in a constant transfer of hitpoints and rapid gain of Magic experience. The downside to this sort of training is the great expense required for the [[runes]]. 

It can be very useful in [[PvP|PvP.]] In PvM, it sees niche use in speedrun strategies and in keeping teammates alive during raids.
